label: Companies House
terms_note: Free REST API (search, company profile, officers, PSCs) with a free API key (600 req / 5 min) → platform-key SALES_COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY; Open Government Licence.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Companies House Public Data API key (free, from https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/). Sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password: 'the Companies House API takes the username as the API key and ignores the password' (https://developer-specs.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/authorisation).

adapter.rate_note: 600 requests per 5 minutes per key (developer guide 'Rate limiting'; client docstring verified 2026-09-05) = 2/s.

me.note: Verified with a one-item company search (Companies House has no account endpoint).

search.note: UK register only: the `country` and `industry` arguments are not search parameters here and are ignored. Search items carry no SIC codes or website; `links.self` is a relative API path, so `url` is left unset (see raw.links.self). `restrictions=active-companies` is a documented option not applied by default.

get_company.note: `id` is the company number from search. `address` is the first line only; the full registered_office_address object and every SIC code are under raw. No website field is documented.

evidence: host api.company-information.service.gov.uk: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://developer-specs.company-information.service.gov.uk/api.ch.gov.uk-specifications/swagger-2.0/spec/swagger.json: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
